svg.title: Devices produce states; the core keeps them
svg.desc: Devices and services feed integrations and add-ons, which feed Home Assistant Core. The core holds the event bus, the state machine, the automation engine, the service registry and the recorder, which writes to SQLite. Clients reach the core over its API.
